evidencePolicy.PASS: Only when executed against actual isolated QA infrastructure with migrations/policies enabled and logs/results attached
evidencePolicy.BLOCKED: No database/test credentials/schema, missing test tenant or missing integration
evidencePolicy.FAIL: Test executed and invariant broken; disallow delivery readiness
evidencePolicy.NOT_EXECUTED: Only scenario defined; does not prove protection
